speaker: william_shakespeare
text: John. The frieze cloak was my lord. He has just said so. He stood at the back like a carter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: From Somerset House. Three nights at Richmond. St Stephen's, St John's, Innocents'. Navarre. The lovers. Something old, to laugh at with a cup. Not the king.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Not the king. He can weep at it in Shoreditch and still leave it there.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He will leave it there. A book out of Antwerp. He said the city. I had not heard the city until he said it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Three nights. I will set them where I set what is promised. Nothing has come in. The office is not filled. He says we shall be paid slow.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Slow. And clean hose for all of us. He did not say whose heel. I am not going to guess a man into a hole.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not chosen. He said something old. He did not name it. I will not name it for him.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then the book has three nights, and the received side empty. That is the whole of it until Kettleby sends the hours.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I will look to my own hose and ask no one whose heel it was.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do. I have told you who the justice was. I am not making a second speech of it.
